paper.title_en: Sensitivity of binary pulsar timing to spin-0 and spin-1 ultralight dark matter
paper.abstract_en: If dark matter consists of ultralight bosons, on galactic scales it can be effectively described as a coherent classical field experiencing oscillations. Such a field could perturb the dynamics of celestial bodies via a direct coupling to ordinary matter, introducing signatures detectable through high-precision pulsar timing analysis. In this work, we extend a two-step Bayesian inference framework, originally developed for linearly coupled scalar ultralight dark matter (ULDM), to probe a quadratic scalar coupling and spin-1 vector dark matter. By explicitly marginalising over nuisance orbital parameters, our approach provides robust sensitivity limits that avoid the artificial overestimation often associated with direct fitting techniques. For quadratic scalar ULDM, we establish new constraints on the coupling $β$ for masses between $2 \times 10^{-22}$ eV and $2 \times 10^{-21}$ eV inaccessible to other experiments, while identifying mass regimes where the sensitivity is dominated by the orbital phase $Ψ'$ or the projected semi-major axis $x$. For vector ULDM, we characterize resonant signatures present even in circular orbits and obtain bounds on the coupling $g$ within the $10^{-23}$ eV to $10^{-18}$ eV range, yielding results within the same orders of magnitude as current laboratory and space-based experiments.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该研究扩展了脉冲星计时对超轻暗物质的贝叶斯推断框架，覆盖二次标量耦合和矢量暗物质，为PTA相关暗物质探测提供了新约束和敏感性分析。
decision.title_zh: 双星脉冲星计时对自旋0和自旋1超轻暗物质的敏感性
decision.abstract_zh: 如果暗物质由超轻玻色子组成，在星系尺度上它可以被有效地描述为一个经历振荡的相干经典场。这样的场可以通过与普通物质的直接耦合扰动天体的动力学，引入可通过高精度脉冲星计时分析探测的签名。在这项工作中，我们将最初为线性耦合标量超轻暗物质（ULDM）开发的两步贝叶斯推断框架，扩展到探测二次标量耦合和自旋1矢量暗物质。通过显式边缘化无关的轨道参数，我们的方法提供了稳健的灵敏度极限，避免了与直接拟合技术常常相关的人为高估。对于二次标量超轻暗物质，我们在其他实验无法触及的质量区间（$2 \times 10^{-22}$ eV 到 $2 \times 10^{-21}$ eV）建立了对耦合常数$β$的新约束，同时确定了灵敏度由轨道相位$Ψ'$或投影半长轴$x$主导的质量范围。对于矢量超轻暗物质，我们表征了即使在圆形轨道中也存在的共振特征，并在$10^{-23}$ eV 到 $10^{-18}$ eV范围内获得了对耦合常数$g$的限制，结果与当前实验室和空间实验在同一数量级内。
